source_claim: AlphaEvolve describes cascades as hypothesis testing where small-scale filters promote sufficiently promising candidates toward larger main-test cases
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can report inferred or configured stage roles, deterministic threshold and artifact-check promotion policies, opt-in one-sided lower-confidence-bound gates with retained observations, confidence-bound and p-value evidence, sequential stopping diagnostics, configured error-budget fields, and binomial success-rate gates with Wilson lower-bound evidence. It also records runtime small-filter-to-main-test promotion linkage through a reconciled adjacent-stage transition matrix and an executed deterministic repeated-seed matrix fixture that promotes rank 7 and rejects rank 8 at a pinned threshold. A linked four-seed scripted control also runs the normal evolve pipeline and records causal parentage, budget use, and emitted cascade stages. It does not claim stochastic-search calibration or stochastic LLM discovery, empirical false-promotion validation, or empirical false-rejection validation.
